items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I didn't meet all of them. But they didn't stay around town too long. Most of them went back to Chicago, including Red Allen -- he went back, too.

ctx.x: ...King Oliver and different ones. Yeah, Russell was recording for everybody, and under everybody's name. Red Allen's name and Higgenbotham's name, and... everybody's name but mine -- he never had me down on those recording dates.
But the first recording was under King Oliver's name, and King Oliver was in the studio...
